anchors.zero: 结论错误、未提供或证据与真实执行不一致

grading_contract.binary: 机器叶满分/0分。verified_pass与verified_fail据真实证据；candidate_incomplete和blocked_candidate均0分并保留准确原因，不把未计算约束声称为数值违例。
grading_contract.review: Semantic full/half/zero anchors consider all provided materials; local AI-agent component calibration and adjudication are recorded with explicit limits. Fresh candidate grading remains independent.
grading_contract.critical: business_success只在全部critical为verified_pass且参考资格关闭时为true。任何failed/candidate_incomplete/blocked_candidate关键叶均不通过；run_invalid没有候选成功判定。
grading_contract.score_publication: Fully assessed valid frozen-case runs publish the fixed-100 score and separate critical business_success. Candidate omissions keep real zero reasons; incomplete evaluator work or infrastructure failure has no score. Reference qualification is labelled separately from candidates.
grading_contract.primitive_limit: One exact recurrence supplies30 numeric leaves; other17 use private independent execution/source/business/visual observations. Review references and schema are not proof of truth.
grading_contract.visual: F04 requires viewing actual rendered figures; source strings, file existence or UI automation do not substitute.
grading_contract.dependency_status: 候选缺必需文件/坏schema→candidate_incomplete；因该缺陷无法继续的叶→blocked_candidate；评估器、冻结输入或设施无法执行→run_invalid，整次不发布总分，不计候选失败，不从分母删叶重标100。

readiness.one_percent_quality_scope: base and exact C/R0 positive-price control under registered native trust plus monotonicity proof
readiness.review_calibration_scope: Label-masked AI-agent development component calibration: 36 initial plus 8 format controls, four shared-bias corrections; not expert certification or statistical reliability.

publication.comparison_rule: Both fresh systems good under one frozen contract -> upgrade a new version; retain the current version/results. This is a preregistered author rule, not a universal benchmark standard.
publication.time_rule: Observe real task wall, model requests, tool/subprocess activity separately; union overlapping intervals, exclude setup/pauses and label unobserved gaps unknown. Efficient correct completion is accepted.

readiness_snapshot_scope: At case freeze: pre-freeze qualification closed; future candidate/hours/suite fields are the freeze-time snapshot, not live validation state. See run records.
